verdict.rationale: Inline commenting on description content is a fair axis for a collaborative work-tracking tool like Trello, so the story applies. The evidence pack never documents comments anchored to specific text or images in a card description. Community remarks about having 'a real discussion on the back of the card' describe card-level comments, an adjacent feature that earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can comment directly on specific text or images within an item's description
